remarks: Discover the perfect blend of space, style, and comfort in this beautifully refreshed, light-filled 1,595 sq. ft. townhome in the highly desirable Gardens community. Move-in ready 3 bedrooms and 2½ baths. Features include double pane windows, new luxury vinyl flooring, new carpet, fresh paint, and new baseboards throughout. The front entrance opens to a spacious living room that flows naturally to the dining area and kitchen with walk-in pantry and two convection ovens, creating a welcoming space for everyday living and entertaining.
